content: Android Auto Backup default ON: backs up getDatabasePath() SQLite files, SharedPreferences, files dir to Google Drive (25MB app quota) and device-to-device transfers; excluded by default only cache/no_backup dirs. android:allowBackup default true. Android 12+ uses dataExtractionRules XML with separate cloud-backup and device-transfer domains. Android Keystore keys never leave the device, so Keystore/EncryptedSharedPreferences-encrypted data restored onto a new device is undecryptable.
